scope: 93 canonical Epoch AI frontier-AI reference sites

stages.DISCOVER: Run the task's site-specific search links and the named source families.
stages.VERIFY_SCOPE: Confirm the source actually identifies the site, campus, parcel, project, utility case or physical observation.
stages.CAPTURE: Record source URL, document/filing/permit/scene locator, publication or record date when exposed, access date, and the exact supported value/observation.
stages.CORROBORATE: For material claims, seek a distinct source origin; mirrored or syndicated copies are not independent corroboration.
stages.CLASSIFY: Use an explicit disposition: FOUND, PUBLIC_LEAD_REVIEW_REQUIRED, NO_PUBLIC_RECORD, SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE, DUPLICATE_OF_EXISTING_SOURCE, or CONFLICT_NEEDS_REVIEW.
stages.INGEST: Submit through the research submission schema; canonical builders remain the state gate.

project.label: Project / program identity
project.objective: Identify the public project/program name corresponding to the site without collapsing a site into a broader corporate initiative.
project.reject: Company-wide initiative with no site linkage.

investors.label: Investors / financing parties
investors.objective: Identify disclosed project-specific financing or investment parties; do not infer them from ownership, tenancy, or ordinary shareholders.
investors.accept: Source explicitly connects the party to financing/investment in the project.
investors.reject: Market shareholders or unrelated financing with no site/project linkage.

construction_companies.label: Construction companies / EPC / GC
construction_companies.objective: Identify site-specific general contractors, EPCs, builders, civil contractors or major construction partners.
construction_companies.accept: The source names the contractor/EPC and ties it to the site/project.
construction_companies.reject: Generic contractor work elsewhere for the same owner.

energy_companies.label: Energy companies / utilities
energy_companies.objective: Identify the site-specific serving utility, power provider, energy partner or disclosed direct-supply counterparty.
energy_companies.accept: Source explicitly connects the company to serving, interconnection, supply, or a site-specific agreement.
energy_companies.reject: Regional utility presence with no site linkage.

owner.label: Owner / legal project entity
owner.objective: Resolve the current site owner/operator entity at the appropriate legal-entity level.
owner.accept: Primary or official public record identifies the entity at the site.
owner.reject: Parent company alone when a site-specific legal entity is disclosed.

users.label: Users / tenants / compute counterparties
users.objective: Identify disclosed site users or tenants without turning general customers or partnerships into site occupancy.
queries: "{site}" Anthropic OR OpenAI OR Google OR Microsoft OR Meta OR Amazon
users.accept: Source explicitly ties the user/tenant/customer relationship to the site/campus.
users.reject: Company-wide customer relationship with no site-specific connection.

address.label: Site address
address.objective: Resolve the most defensible public physical address or site location string.
address.accept: Direct official/primary address or two independent public sources.
address.reject: Geocoding guesses or nearby mailing addresses without site linkage.

chip_quantities.label: Chip / accelerator quantities
chip_quantities.objective: Capture site-specific accelerator counts or chip-type quantities only when explicitly attributed to the site.
chip_quantities.accept: Site-specific quantity is explicitly published or preserved in a canonical site-level source.
chip_quantities.reject: Global shipment/ownership estimates without site allocation.

service_or_contract.label: Service / energy contract
service_or_contract.objective: Find site-specific utility service, capacity reservation, power purchase, direct supply, or contractual energy evidence.
service_or_contract.accept: Document identifies the site and contractual/service relationship.
service_or_contract.reject: Generic tariff availability or regional service.

regulatory.label: Regulatory / permitting
regulatory.objective: Collect site-specific planning, zoning, building, environmental, water, air, tax-incentive, or utility proceedings.
regulatory.accept: Official record clearly pertains to the site/project.
regulatory.reject: General policy or program pages without a site-specific action.

compute_tenancy.label: Compute tenancy / occupancy
compute_tenancy.objective: Establish site-specific tenant/operator/customer evidence for compute infrastructure.
compute_tenancy.accept: Site-specific occupancy or tenancy directly documented.
compute_tenancy.reject: A company's general use of cloud or data centers.

power_telemetry.label: Power observations / telemetry
power_telemetry.objective: Find measured or reported electrical consumption/demand attributable to the site while keeping annual aggregates separate from interval telemetry.
power_telemetry.accept: Numeric observation with clear site scope and measurement period/type.
power_telemetry.reject: Queue MW, service capacity, generation capacity, or contracted demand presented as measured load.

remote_sensing.label: Remote sensing
remote_sensing.objective: Acquire repeatable optical/TIR/SAR evidence for construction, surface/thermal change, and campus evolution.
remote_sensing.accept: Reproducible scene plus derived observation with provenance.
remote_sensing.reject: A satellite image link with no retained observation/processing record.

cooling.label: Cooling infrastructure
cooling.objective: Identify site-level cooling equipment, cooling plant design, water use, heat rejection, or cooling infrastructure.
cooling.accept: Cooling evidence is site-specific and source-backed.
cooling.reject: Generic data-center cooling design not tied to the site.

transformer_supply_chain.label: Transformer supply chain
transformer_supply_chain.objective: Find site-specific transformer specification, procurement, shipment, delivery, installation, or energization evidence.
transformer_supply_chain.accept: Event tied to the site or its electrical project.
transformer_supply_chain.reject: Manufacturer product announcement with no site linkage.

independent_corroboration.label: Independent corroboration
independent_corroboration.objective: Attach a materially independent public source corroborating a site-specific claim already supported elsewhere.
independent_corroboration.accept: Second source has a distinct origin and supports the same site-specific claim.
independent_corroboration.reject: Mirror copies, syndicated duplicates, or self-referential reposts.

grid_connection.label: Grid connection / interconnection
grid_connection.objective: Resolve the site-specific public connection record or documented utility/grid relationship, while distinguishing verified queue IDs from site-level evidence and jurisdiction-only context.
search: serving utility interconnection and large-load filings
capture: queue or project ID if exposed
grid_connection.accept: A public record explicitly identifies the site and its connection/service relationship or queue/project identifier.
grid_connection.reject: A jurisdiction-level queue record that cannot be defensibly matched to the site.

chip_inventory.label: Chip inventory / site hardware
chip_inventory.objective: Verify site-specific accelerator inventory and chip-type attribution from canonical or primary site records; preserve uncertainty where only estimates exist.
chip_inventory.accept: A site-specific chip inventory or clearly attributed estimate is preserved with its source and date.
chip_inventory.reject: Global chip ownership/users/shipment figures without site allocation.
